title: Smart Warehousing
description: Put rack tilt at the centre of warehouse monitoring, with selected storage, equipment and workplace measurements linked to inspection, stock review and EHS response.

title: Smart Infrastructure
description: Combine tilt, project-selected structural vibration and distance measurements with weather, temperature and water context to support targeted infrastructure inspection.

title: Smart Equipment Monitoring
description: Monitor vibration, temperature, pressure and nearby water leaks. Combine equipment feedback with permitted control actions to guide maintenance.

title: Smart Buildings
description: Connect indoor air and climate, water leaks and room-use context with building operations and selected equipment feedback.

title: Smart Irrigation
description: Monitor root-zone needs, control compatible irrigation valves and pumps, and verify delivery with position, flow and pressure feedback.

title: Smart Pipework Monitoring
description: Connect ambient TVOC, pipe-surface temperature and process pressure with equipment and operating context for a focused process-area investigation.

title: Smart Logistics
description: Connect cargo temperature and humidity records, selected location reports and handover events to investigate exposure and make a documented receiving decision.

title: Smart Water Leak Monitoring
description: Combine water-contact detection with selected level and environmental measurements to locate affected areas, investigate the source and verify monitoring after recovery.

title: Smart Water Monitoring
description: Connect water level, pressure and selected site context across pipes, chambers, tanks and channels to investigate rising water and abnormal operating patterns.

title: Smart Asset Tracking
description: Locate outdoor assets using the latest reported position, then add selected condition and service records to support collection, maintenance and redeployment.

title: Smart Greenhouses
description: Connect crop-zone climate and root conditions with permitted ventilation and irrigation commands, then verify equipment and water-delivery feedback.

title: Smart Museums & Archives
description: Connect collection climate and light with selected water or air-quality observations, giving conservation and facilities teams a shared basis for investigating change.
